findings.message: 15 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 28 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Educación de calidad" (pill) above "Excelencia Académica"; "Educación de calidad" (pill) above "Excelencia Académica"; "Educación de calidad" (pill) above "Excelencia Académica"; "97 Años de Excelencia" (pill) above "Tu Mejor Decisión Educativa"; "97 Años de Excelencia" (pill) above "Tu Mejor Decisión Educativa"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 23 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Educación de calidad", "97 Años de Excelencia", "Educación de calidad", "97 Años de Excelencia").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 17 gradient fill(s): div.slide-overlay-mejorado → linear-gradient(105deg, rgba(31, 35, 102, 0.88) 0%, rgba(31, 35, 102, 0.6) 50%, rgba(31, 35, 102, 0.3) 100%) | div.slide-overlay-mejorado → linear-gradient(105deg, rgba(31, 35, 102, 0.88) 0%, rgba(31, 35, 102, 0.6) 50%, rgba(31, 35, 102, 0.3) 100%) | div.slide-overlay-mejorado → linear-gradient(105deg, rgba(31, 35, 102, 0.88) 0%, rgba(31, 35, 102, 0.6) 50%, rgba(31, 35, 102, 0.3) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 49 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.btn.btn-primary → rgba(246, 190, 0, 0.35) 0px 12px 26px 0px | div.hero-stats-card-3d → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) 0px 25px 50px 0px | div.hero-actions → rgba(17, 22, 52, 0.18) 0px 14px 34px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 55 text-shadow(s).
findings.fix: Remove; fix legibility with a scrim or a different crop.

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 21 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.header-two 1440px | ul.list-inline 288px | ul.list-inline 288px | ul.list-inline 288px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 25 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 94 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: Unreadable text: "Kindergarten" 1.1:1 (#ffffff on #f5f7fa); "Metodología Montessori" 1.1:1 (#ffffff on #f5f7fa); "Primaria" 1.1:1 (#ffffff on #f5f7fa); "Metodología Singapur" 1.1:1 (#ffffff on #f5f7fa)
findings.fix: Raise contrast to at least 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large display.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 91 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 20 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (it has no size yet).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 100px from the left edge but only to 165px from the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("Excelencia Académica") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: 3 h1 elements.
findings.fix: One h1 per page; section titles are h2.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Excelencia Académica" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Académica" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "1.000+" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "El Futuro de tus Hijos Comienza Aquí" (screen 2, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 652px of nothing between: "Nuestras metodologías"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: The h1 is 21px ("Excelencia Académica").
findings.fix: Set the title at display size, or make the large text of the first screen the h1.

findings.message: 10 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Convenios con las mejores instituciones" → 3 lines (5 words, 40px); "Campus espacios para aprender" → 3 lines (4 words, 40px); "Crecimiento acompañamos cada etapa" → 3 lines (4 words, 40px); "Convenios con las mejores instituciones" → 3 lines (5 words, 40px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: A 388px stretch at 3440px holds nothing.
findings.fix: Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: 8 text block(s) sit 12–15px from the phone's edge: "Descubre una educación innovad" (16px); "Unidad Educativa Particular Ra" (15px); "Dirección" (15px)
findings.fix: The page margin is 16–20px on a phone; the header and the corner labels sit on it too.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 3 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "WhatsApp Directo", "Enviar Formulario", "Asistente Virtual"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
